# 1 Enoch Chapter 48 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Ge'ez MS | **Section:** Book of Parables

---

**48:1** In that place I saw the spring of righteousness — a spring that never ran dry. All around it were many more springs of wisdom, and all who were thirsty drank and were filled with wisdom. And they lived there with the righteous, the holy, and the chosen.

**48:2** At that very moment, the Son of Man was given his name in the presence of the Lord of Spirits — his name was announced before the Head of Days.

**48:3** Even before the sun and the heavenly signs were created, before the stars were set in place — his name was already named before the Lord of Spirits.

**48:4** He will be the support on which the righteous lean so they do not fall. He will be the light of the nations and the hope of the brokenhearted.

**48:5** All who live on earth will bow before him in worship, and will praise and bless and glorify the Lord of Spirits.

**48:6** This is why he was chosen and kept hidden in God's presence before the world was made — and will remain so forever.

**48:7** The wisdom of the Lord of Spirits has made him known to the holy and righteous. He has kept safe the destiny of the righteous, because they turned their backs on this unrighteous world — rejecting its deeds and its ways in the name of the Lord of Spirits. And in his name they are saved; it is by his good pleasure that they live.

**48:8** In those days, the kings of the earth and the powerful will hang their heads in shame because of what they have done. On the day of their suffering and anguish, they will have no way to save themselves.

**48:9** I will hand them over to my chosen ones. Like straw in a fire they will burn in the presence of the holy. Like lead dropped in water they will sink before the righteous, and no trace of them will remain.

**48:10** On the day of their ruin, the earth will find rest. They will fall before the righteous and never get up again. There will be no one to lift them up, because they denied the Lord of Spirits and his Anointed One. Blessed be the name of the Lord of Spirits.

---

*PNEUMA notes: Chapter 48 is the theological summit of all of 1 Enoch. Three foundational claims are made here that will reverberate through all of messianic Judaism and early Christianity: (1) the Son of Man's name pre-exists creation (v. 3); (2) he is the fulfillment of Isaiah's Servant as "light to the nations" (v. 4); (3) he is identified as God's Anointed — the Messiah (v. 10).*
